items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: John never worked in the record department. He met some of the engineers, that would be in the 1950s.

ctx.x: Something like that. John didn't marry Benny Goodman's sister, no. I think it was the other way around. Well, anyway, Hammond was supposed to write the Bessie Smith chapter. I remember once I did get a few questions in. He said, well, sometime we'll get together, and he would dictate it, and I was supposed to write it down. And I was just there. I had no intention of working with him on anything.
